intent.proves: Product images with a default: images-without-default satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailProductId = p.ProductId AND d.DetailType = 0 AND ISNULL(d.DetailVariantId, N'') = N'') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailProductId = p.ProductId AND d.DetailType = 0 AND d.DetailIsDefault = 1)
